title: Report board identity
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*). Do not guess a host and do not ask for one.

Call device_info, or device_exec with the command `hostname`. Record evidence with record_evidence (include task_id): metric `hostname`, observed = the trimmed hostname and nothing else.

Do not change the board. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration.
